objective: Materialize a canonical high-complexity execution-candidate Plan package for PCS-001 through PCS-008 from one finalized schema-first machine source.

blockers.detail: The closed Plan source v1 schema has no fields for global layering, implementation-detail task contracts, Distill evidence, dispatch trace, blocker ledger, transport/result/handoff receipts, or the complete execution-entry projection.
The installed compiler derives only the WPRA config, human Work Pack, source validation receipt, and two WPRA run directories.
Creating missing companions independently would create parallel model-authored authorities instead of deterministic projections of one machine source.
Without one complete canonical Plan package and exact WPRA-bound execution-entry projection, Implementation Readiness cannot truthfully issue PLAN_IMPLEMENTATION_READY.

first_future_unit_reason: PCS-001 remains the narrowest reversible trust repair, but this planning run grants no mutation authority and cannot expose it to Task Session before canonical source and producer closure exists.

minimum_unblock.action: Add a versioned, v1-compatible canonical Plan source/profile and installed producer that deterministically derives every required high-complexity companion from one source, then rerun materialization from the unchanged refinement evidence.
minimum_unblock.authority_required_now: none for this blocker receipt; separate implementation authorization is required before canonical producer changes
